dvids.title: Hegseth Speaks to Returning Aircraft Carrier Crew
dvids.desc: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth speaks to sailors during an all hands call aboard the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln near San Diego, Oct. 7, 2026. The ship is returning home after a more than 300-day deployment that included supporting operations in the Arabian Sea.

dvids.title: CENTCOM Maintains Strict Enforcement of U.S. Blockade Against Iran
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — On Oct. 5, U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) forces redirected the 130th commercial vessel in the Middle East during strict enforcement of the ongoing U.S. naval blockade against Iran.
